purpose: Fixed retrospective source-date-causal screen of repaired low-liquidity ranker for the user TP5/H10 and cadence target. Necessary research evidence only; never automatic promotion.
prior_evidence: Inherited H5 SURVIVED report inadmissible after h4zv. Current adjustment as-of instability audited in xi1c. Old scores/models/picks are not reused. No corrected-candidate test scores or outcomes have been inspected.

source.input_rule: Discard dates after each fit/prediction cutoff BEFORE adjustment. Training features may use only information available by fit cutoff; each test-day feature uses that day prefix. Never load delist_date/exited or future labels into predictors. Historical raw revisions/publication times and heuristic factors are not certified by a date prefix. Independent corporate-action/price verification and true forward evidence remain promotion requirements.

feature_rules: Causal rolling formulas from legacy harness, using date-limited adjusted prices and actual amount for liquidity. OBV difference computed as rolling signed-volume sum (algebraic equivalent); full-history consecutive-up count. Per-row market, prior-session market-cap weights and shifted index context. No outcome-based universe filter. Clip predictor values to [-10000,10000], missing remaining predictors retained for LightGBM.

contract.unfilled_entry: Keep selected record, zero touch and zero net; do not replace or delay entry. Also report filled-only rates.
contract.terminal_or_missing: Keep pending/data_error; no last-quote liquidation fiction and no dropping from evaluation. Any unresolved price/exit or missing control blocks qualification.
contract.target_label: Binary H10 +5 touch including zero for complete no-touch windows. Training requires full market horizon and valid OHLCV, fillable entry and terminal resolution. Label availability is horizon-end session, even for early touches; require <= fit cutoff.

model.noise_control: Three identical rankers on 35 independent N(0,1) inputs, seeds0,1,2. Separate deterministic train and per-date prediction RNG streams. No seed switching or hyperparameter search.

cadence.additional_cumulative_cap: Before each session n (1-based), allow fire only if prior total fires + 1 <= floor(3*n/5), in addition to original rolling5 constraint. Candidate top3 is unchanged; blocked dates are ABSTAIN, no carry/replacement.

evaluation.scope: Entire fixed 2026Q3 signal window, calendar inferred from all observed market dates in frozen panel; cross-check calendar completeness before qualification. No performance output before the entire H10 window is available. Save score/universe/cadence artifacts first.
evaluation.same_day_controls: All same-date market/liquidity/feature-eligible nonselected tickers; identical contract, maturity, costs and unfilled handling. Report each market separately, combined primary; no post-hoc market-subset promotion.
evaluation.placebo: Random-ticker relabel within each date and market at equal selected counts,5000draws; circular firing-date shifts diagnostic only. Same-date paired primary-vs-noise comparison, mean of3noise seeds; no improvement claim below0.3pp.
evaluation.family_scope: Original lowliq schedule, this cumulative-boundary amendment, and two current KR60/120 studies. Keep original studies unchanged; apply family4 to this amended screen. Not correction for entire historical search.
evaluation.secondary_seeds: Report all, never choose the best; primary0 must pass all primary gates. No independent feature-increment claim without three-seed/equal-noise comparison.

kill_rule: At the fixed mature/source-complete evaluation any target miss rejects this candidate for promotion. Missing/unverified source evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE_SOURCE, not a profitable/losing trade. No interim promotion, outcome-driven extension, threshold or direction change, or reselection.

publication.reason: Retrospective screen only. Requires independent source checks, immutable forward current-epoch evidence, existing category-specific release gates and full consumer wiring before replacing a lane. Passing pooled statistics cannot certify a category. Existing producer hash and KR60/120 studies unchanged.

amendment.reason: Rolling3per5 alone can give38firingdates/62sessions=3.0645 per5 at full eligibility. Add cumulative prefix cap floor(3*elapsed_calendar_sessions/5) before outcomes. A single deterministic boundary correction, no schedule/phase/threshold search. Preserve and report original as a separate family member.
amendment.evidence_seen: Model fitting receipts and20/62Q3 universe/score records; no corrected-candidate test labels, touch rates, returns, or outcome-derived selection. The boundary issue is combinatorial, independent of prices/labels.
amendment.frozen_models: Reuse all six original fitted models and immutable full-universe scores after original reconstruction completes; verify original manifest and per-model/per-date hashes. Never refit or use model scores to choose calendar phase.
amendment.interpretation: Frequency primary is 5*firing_dates/total_test_calendar_sessions, including abstention dates; additional rolling5 maximum3 still applies. Early prefixes may have fewer than2per5; lower2 bound assessed only on complete fixed test window.
amendment.reuse_disclosure: Same historical window and models as parent, with pre-outcome deterministic timing amendment. Neither arm is genuine unseen forward evidence.
